note: The engine is unmodified upstream rhwp v0.9.1 (memo API included), rebuilt by scripts/build-engine.sh with the Android WebView flags (-Ctarget-cpu=mvp, -Zbuild-std); there is no engine patch. The runtime tracked under app/src/main/assets/engine is the old 0.8.7 npm build and is only a placeholder: CI (and local builds) overwrite it with the rebuilt engine before packaging, and verifyMemoEngine rejects anything without the generated build-info.json. Generated hashes are stored in engine/build-info.json inside the APK build artifact.
